kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أرتئس (form VIII)
# أَرْتَئِسُ (ʔartaʔisu) /ʔar.ta.ʔi.su/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَأَسَ (irtaʔasa)
# أَرْتَئِسَ (ʔartaʔisa) /ʔar.ta.ʔi.sa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَأَسَ (irtaʔasa)
# أَرْتَئِسْ (ʔartaʔis) /ʔar.ta.ʔis/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِرْتَأَسَ (irtaʔasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
